evidence.excerpt: These issues motivate us to study two fundamental questions: when should a self-evolving system stop, and what should it output once it stops?

evidence.excerpt: For example, on SearchQA with SkillOpt and DeepSeek V4 Flash, our method stops at round 4 rather than the full budget of 40, reducing token usage by 91.6% while achieving 82.43% unseen-test accuracy versus 82.00% under the full-budget run.
